title: Enqueue typed state events atomically with their committed revision
outcome: Server state publication preserves commit order by enqueueing typed events with revision allocation under the same state lock, leaving serialization off-lock.
acceptance: 1. A deterministic concurrent publisher test proves revision-order delivery through the actual AppState broadcaster; lock-hold measurement and a paused-serialization test confirm serialization remains outside the state lock.
2. Each commit's revision and typed publication work enter one ordered mailbox under the same state lock; retained snapshots and deltas preserve that commit order through publication.
3. The server contract documentation describes commit/enqueue atomicity and off-lock serialization, and the full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed input.
